data.name: Leviathan
data.detailed_description:
Leviathan is a multiplayer extraction shooter set in a sci-fi universe where humanity has been abducted by a gargantuan, interstellar beast and changed over the course of several millennia. The abducted were ultimately discarded onto foreign planets. To survive, they have been forced to evolved into three factions of biologically and ideologically distinct lifeforms. Recently, a second wave of abductions have occurred. Fate has brought them together to the surface of the bountiful world of Domusalus; where only ONE FACTION can establish dominance for their survival.

Fight for control of Domusalus as one of these factions:

• Terran – Strength is paramount. Given the chance to demonstrate their might to the weaker factions, they will surely establish dominance. Domusalus, being rich in natural resources their home planet is greatly lacking, shows itself as an opportunity to conquer. After previously living in such hostile environments, the Terran have no intentions of sharing this wealth – the other factions are merely an obstacle in their path to claim what is theirs.

• Faunian – The Faunian believe in the preservation of natural life. If any being was to show disrespect to this order, that being is considered a pollutant that must be cleansed from the ecosystem. After seeing the other factions taking selfish advantage of the planet’s resources, the Faunian ready themselves to protect it, even if it means total extinction of the opposition, and the native Domi people.

• Angel – With golden metallic bodies, the Angel have discarded their ties to humanity. In doing so, they have become virtually immortal and seek to "upgrade" all other lifeforms in the same way. Believing that this is the only way for advancement, any who resist are marked at as primitive beings that require immediate extermination.

Key Features

• Three playable factions – each with a mysterious shared history!

• Hundreds of items - weapons, ammo, armor, grenades, restoratives and more!

• Explore the “Aurelian Wilds” - a HUGE map offering unique areas, enemies, loot and extractions!

• High risk/High reward - fight against (and loot!) both AI and Player opponents!

• Play solo or in teams of three – take the loot for yourself OR work together to enhance survivability!

• Capture outposts – make your mark to boost your faction's domination over the planet!

data.short_description: Play as 1 of 3 factions in the fight for control of Domusalus, but beware the Kaecillian menace who threaten both locals and warring factions. Deploy with your gear, search for upgraded loot, and escape in time to keep it for your next assault for planetary dominance.
